reviews.comment: Elective class, not oral or written comm credit, first time uni administering this class... There is tmi in lectures, it's hard to tell what we need to know. weekly written assignments and "presenting" style homework replaces homework already submitted. Taught like a STEM class even though it is an MGMT/SOCI elective. written exams. Seems like CBK.

If you want to be an entrepreneur one day you MUST take at least one of his classes. Learned so much from this class mainly because it's an open discussion and he teaches from experience. Classes are long since they're only one day a week, but time goes by pretty fast. Definitely would take any class he teaches!

Professor Hakim is an excellent professor! He cares so much about his students and isn't like any other class. His class is really long, but if you do the assigned readings and care about entrepreneurship then it is a GEM of a class. He is also very accessible outside class times and will work with you.
